description: This file defines a Java interface named AccountNumberFormatWritePlatformService, which specifies methods for creating, updating, and deleting account number formats within the Fineraft project.

classes.name: AccountNumberFormatWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface for account number format operations such as create, update, and delete.

methods.name: createAccountNumberFormat
methods.description: Creates a new account number format based on the provided JSON command.

methods.name: updateAccountNumberFormat
methods.description: Updates an existing account number format identified by ID with data from the JSON command.

methods.name: deleteAccountNumberFormat
methods.description: Deletes an account number format by ID.
